title: Verify Administrator can edit work order header fields (customer, asset, service advisor, lead technician, status)
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Administrator role. (this role has Work Orders: Create and Edit, which gates header field edits per spec v33).
At least one work order exists.
steps:
1. Click Work Orders in the main navigation and open a work order.
2. In the work order header, change the Customer to a different customer and save.
3. Change the Asset to a different asset and save.
4. Change the Service Advisor to a different user and save.
5. Change the Lead Technician to a different user and save.
6. Change the work order Status and save.
7. Refresh the page.
expected: Every edit in steps 2-6 is allowed and saves without a permission error. After refreshing (step 7), all updated values persist.
